about: The websocket messages about tablets, as the integration sends them.
tests/test_tablet_shapes.py checks the integration against this file.
tests/frontend/tablet-shapes.test.mjs checks the panel's stand-in Home
Assistant (tests/harness/mock-hass.js) and the panel's word lists.
Change this file, the integration and the stand-in together.
rules: A Tablet has exactly the keys of 'tablet', each with its type, pattern and list of values.
'reason' is '' unless 'reasons' lists the status; then it is one of those reasons.
'retry' is false unless the status is 'failed', and false for a reason in 'no_retry'.
'short_name' is 'name' without a trailing 'strip' text (any case); a trailing 'tag' stays.
'model' is the device's model, 'TAB-1' when the device has none.
A tablet with status 'no_dashboard' has 'dashboard' null.

A tablet no admin approved yet has 'approved' false and status 'new', and only it has that status. It shows nothing: 'dashboard' null, 'paired' false, 'input' 'not_paired'. 'suggested' is what it showed before it lost its approval, or null.
Tablet lists are sorted by name in lower case, then MAC, comparing code points. MACs are unique.
Dashboards are sorted by title in lower case, then url_path, comparing code points.
'shown_on' lists, sorted, the MACs of the tablets whose 'dashboard' is that url_path.
'tablets' counts the approved tablets; 'sent_to_tablets' is true when one of them is 'on_tablet'.

Assigning a dashboard to a tablet that is not approved approves it only with 'approve' true, which only the panel's "Turn on with this dashboard" sends; without it the answer is the error 'not_approved' (the commands are admin only). An approved tablet switches with or without 'approve'.

'reauth' is what Home Assistant waits for from an admin, under Settings > Repairs, before ESPHome connects to the tablet again: one of 'reauths' ('erased': confirm that the tablet was erased; 'key': it asks for a key), or null. 'reauth_name' is the name Repairs gives it ("Authentication expired for <reauth_name>"), null exactly when 'reauth' is null.
The panel treats a reason it does not know by 'retry'.
